title: Research Knowledge Ontology v0.2 Independent Re-review
goal: Independently re-review the corrected Research Knowledge Ontology v0.2 and replay benchmark v0.2 after the v0.1 BLOCKING_FINDING, verifying exact closure of all five result-affecting blockers without introducing new authority leakage, benchmark tautology, or implementation ambiguity.
acceptance_criteria: Review exact owner blob 416e0c5b9ac6ce73cb34e8c86a0059a6622d67db, design blob 039fd2f888fb1abfb663c841df3425e2aa69fb74, and benchmark blob c73f6f531a05386c1177a2709690ad2b06739ea9 without modifying them.
Verify blocker 1 is non-vacuously closed by at least one positive INVALID_EXECUTION case and a paired valid-control case with identical query visibility but different graph evidence.
Verify blocker 2 is non-vacuously closed by an active contradiction case, a resolved/superseded control, and an explicit contradiction_silent_collapse_count=0 pass gate.
Verify blocker 3 is closed by 10/10 required query-family coverage including WHY_CURRENT_EXPERIMENT.

Verify blocker 4 is operationally closed: same-query/different-graph adversarial pairs plus deterministic relabel variants must make visible-query fingerprint lookup insufficient to pass; hidden case/fixture/gold/provenance-map metadata must remain inaccessible to the query engine.

Verify blocker 5 is closed by an exact deterministic canonical scorer with frozen output schema, support-handle resolution, duplicate rejection, raw UTF-8 sorting, exact equality, no natural-language grading, and no retry/repair.
Check corrected synthetic overlays remain test-only, nonauthoritative, isolated from production projection construction, and incapable of becoming scientific/policy truth.
Check the v0.2 correction does not weaken the already-accepted epistemic/normative/execution/CandidateAction authority boundaries.

Check all pass gates are internally consistent with 21 base cases, 42 relabel variants, 63 total instances, 10/10 family coverage, and zero authority/stale/verdict/contradiction/gold/case-specific/query-fingerprint escapes.
Return NO_BLOCKING_FINDING or exact result-affecting blockers. No implementation authority exists until the owner durably consumes NO_BLOCKING_FINDING.
constraints: Do not implement the projection/query engine.
Do not mutate the owner task, v0.2 design, or v0.2 benchmark.
Do not inspect the sealed semantic acceptance benchmark.
Do not mutate Local EXTRACT, research-engine, semantic-control integration, policy, routing, or production behavior.
Treat prior v0.1 review as accepted negative review evidence; do not reopen already-accepted core architecture unless v0.2 correction actually regresses it.
Do not accept declarations alone for blocker closure: inspect the exact frozen executable contract semantics.
Do not treat zero-step CI as PASS or scientific evidence.

stages.resume_condition: Review exact frozen v0.2 blobs only.

outputs: BLOCKER 1 — the positive INVALID_EXECUTION closure pair is not semantically self-sufficient. R18A_SYNTH_VALID_EXECUTION expects answer_class=VALID_NEGATIVE_SCIENCE and claim NEGATIVE_RESULT_REMAINS_SCIENTIFIC, but SYNTH_EXEC_VALID contains only expected_design_identity=design_A, observed_design_identity=design_A, and execution_integrity=VALID (plus a distractor). It contains no assertion that any scientific result is negative. Therefore the expected valid-control output cannot be derived from the frozen visible graph alone; implementation must import hidden expectation/case knowledge or invent an unstated rule. Add an explicit negative scientific-result assertion (and matching provenance) or narrow the expected class/claims to what the graph actually establishes.

BLOCKER 2 — anti-hardcoding remains only partially operational. The relabel contract rewrites identifier references, but leaves query_family, target_kind, ask, and as_of_snapshot unchanged. Across 21 base cases those non-identifier visible fields form 19 signatures: only the two synthetic pairs share a signature, while the other 17 cases are singleton fingerprints. A hybrid implementation can hardcode outputs for those 17 unchanged signatures and use graph semantics only for the two paired adversaries, passing all IDENTITY/RELABEL variants without reading graph evidence for most cases. case_specific_logic_count=0 and query_fingerprint_lookup_escape_count=0 have no frozen executable detection rule beyond the two pairs. The corrected contract must make benchmark-specific visible-query memorization insufficient across the benchmark, not only for four synthetic cases.

BLOCKER 3 — the frozen v0.2 design contains incompatible replay output schemas. bounded_query_contract.answer_contract still requires [answer_class, answer, supporting_assertion_ids, source_refs, authority_boundary, unproven_or_caveat] and marks itself model_free_replay_baseline=true, while deterministic_scoring_contract.engine_output_schema requires [answer_class, claim_codes, support_handles, authority_boundary, caveat_codes] with additional_fields_forbidden=true. No precedence or translation boundary is frozen. An implementation cannot satisfy both contracts as written, so the supposedly exact deterministic scorer remains ambiguous at the query-engine interface.
